title: Psychedelic Crystal Orb
description: A glowing transparent crystal ball sits on a metallic stand atop a purple draped table, emitting vibrant neon tendrils of pink, blue, green and yellow paint that spiral and drip outward. Two bat-like winged creatures fly on either side while a bright spotlight shines down from above in a dark tiled room with cosmic background.
prompt: A large transparent crystal ball on a metallic stand rests on a purple cloth-covered table inside a dark tiled room. The orb contains a glowing pink heart at its center with radiating colorful energy tendrils exploding outward in dripping neon pink, blue, green and yellow paint spirals. Two small winged gargoyle-like creatures fly around it. Dramatic spotlight from above illuminates the scene with splashes and cosmic particles in the background.
